name: whatsapp-chat-recovery
description: Privacy-first WhatsApp recovery and read-only forensic triage for backups, exports, Chromium IndexedDB/LevelDB artifacts, Google Drive, and local evidence copies.

interface.shortDescription: Recover and audit your own WhatsApp backups and browser artifacts.
interface.longDescription: Guided WhatsApp recovery with read-only inventory of Android backups, exports, and Chromium/WhatsApp Web IndexedDB-LevelDB artifacts. Includes multilingual export detection, hashing, exact JID/LID searches, and forensic handoff guidance. Native cloud backups must still be restored through WhatsApp; the plugin never bypasses encryption. Adds CRC32C-validated scanning for intact LevelDB log records embedded in fragments, with offsets and hit counts but no payload output.
